test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Article _________ of the Indian constitution provides for superintendence, direction and control of elections vested in an Election commission.
solution:
The correct option is __**324.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 324 **of the Indian constitution provides for **superintendence, direction and control of elections** vested in an Election commission.
 
• The Election Commission of India is an** autonomous constitutional body **responsible for** administering elections** in India at** national, state and district levels.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 336 **deals with the provisions for the **appointment of Election Commission** and the **Chief Election Commissioner.**
 
• **Article 338** deals with the** composition of the Election Commission** and the conditions of service of Election Commissioners.
 
• **Article 330 **deals with the **reservation of seats for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes **in the Lok Sabha and the State Legislative Assemblies.
